_note: Pinned against kasm-session-runtime's v0.2.102 tag. Release tags no longer carry an -rc.N suffix: a release is exactly v<commit-count version>, so `branch` here is the plain version. This release adds named sidebars (that repo's docs/sidebar-hosting.md section 2): the sidebar tarball gains select.sh and install.sh --name, and a session picks a sidebar with KASM_RUNTIME_SIDEBAR=<name> (kasm-xvnc resolves it, kasm-setup builds `default` on request; KASM_VNC_PATH=/usr/share/kasmvnc-agent still works). The runtime binary itself is functionally unchanged from v0.2.96-rc.1. The sidebar (pkgs/kasm-ai-runtime-sidebar) is pinned to the same commit -- bump both together. Hashes computed by downloading both published objects (curl) and taking sha256-<base64 of the raw SHA-256 digest>, the same value nix's fixed-output check computes for a fetchurl. Re-pin the same way: download kasm-session-runtime-linux-<amd64|arm64>.<tag>.<short> and kasm-ai-runtime-sidebar.tar.gz.<tag>.<short>, hash, update.
